system_description.narrative_title: Global bond sell-off and Fed-rate uncertainty
system_description.narrative_summary: A surprisingly strong U.S. jobs report has revived expectations of tighter Fed policy, driving up Treasury yields and triggering a broader global bond sell-off. Large holders and market participants — from Norway’s sovereign wealth manager to hedge funds and sovereign actors — are reconsidering U.S. debt exposure, amplifying liquidity, price-discovery and cross‑market spillovers into equities, commodities and crypto while political actors pressure monetary policy. The system is reacting to macro data, central-bank signaling and strategic shifts in sovereign/institutional asset allocations, producing feedback loops that can intensify volatility and policy risk.
system_description.scope: Developed-market sovereign bond markets (US Treasuries and equivalents), investor expectations and positioning, US macro data (jobs, inflation), Federal Reserve policy signaling, major institutional/sovereign holders (sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, hedge funds), and market liquidity/price discovery mechanisms.
system_description.super_system: Global financial system and world economy (cross-border capital flows, exchange rates, global growth and trade)
adjacent_subsystems: Equity markets (risk assets and cross-asset correlations)
Commodity and energy markets (oil, gas, and energy-related corporate credit)
Geopolitics and trade policy (state deals, sanctions, political pressure on monetary policy)

variables.name: Policy interest rate level
variables.description: The current short-term policy interest rate set by monetary authorities, measured as a continuous nominal percentage.

variables.name: Central bank forward guidance
variables.description: The intensity and directional stance of monetary authorities' communications about future policy, measured by frequency and hawkish/dovish tilt.

variables.name: Market expectations of policy
variables.description: Market-implied probability distribution of future monetary policy actions and timing, expressed continuously across horizons.

variables.name: Macro data momentum
variables.description: The recent trend and surprise magnitude in key macro indicators (employment, inflation, output) aggregated into a continuous momentum score.

variables.name: Sovereign/institutional sovereign-debt allocations
variables.description: The proportion of large institutional and sovereign portfolios allocated to developed-market sovereign debt, measured as a continuous share of assets.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease of executing sizeable trades in sovereign bond markets without large price impact, measured as a continuous liquidity depth metric.

variables.name: Bond market volatility
variables.description: The magnitude and variability of short-term price movements in sovereign bond markets, measured as a continuous volatility index.

variables.name: Cross-market spillovers
variables.description: The strength and speed of transmission of shocks between sovereign bonds and other asset classes (equities, commodities, crypto), measured as a continuous coupling intensity.

variables.name: Demand for safe assets
variables.description: Aggregate investor preference for low-risk sovereign instruments relative to riskier assets, measured as a continuous demand index.

variables.name: Term-structure slope
variables.description: The slope of the sovereign yield curve across maturities (short vs long), measured as the continuous difference between benchmark yields.

variables.name: Portfolio duration exposure
variables.description: The average interest-rate sensitivity (duration) of aggregated bond holdings across investors, measured as a continuous duration metric.

variables.name: Market leverage and margin pressure
variables.description: The aggregate degree of leverage and susceptibility to margin calls in fixed-income markets, measured as a continuous leverage ratio and margin-sensitivity indicator.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net international capital movements into and out of developed-market sovereign debt, measured as a continuous flow volume.

variables.name: Price-discovery efficiency
variables.description: The effectiveness and speed with which markets incorporate information into sovereign bond prices, measured as a continuous signal-to-noise metric.

variables.name: Political pressure on monetary policy
variables.description: The intensity and consistency of political actors' efforts to influence monetary decision-making, measured as a continuous pressure index.

variables.name: Risk premia level
variables.description: The compensation investors require for holding sovereign bonds above the risk-free baseline, measured as a continuous premium across maturities.

catalysts.title: U.S. CPI (mid‑September)
catalysts.description: Release of U.S. consumer price inflation for August will provide a direct signal on inflation momentum and near‑term Fed policy bets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Will US inflation data persuade the Fed to raise rates this month?' and investors poring over inflation data.

catalysts.title: FOMC meeting / policy decision (mid‑September)
catalysts.description: The Federal Reserve's scheduled policy meeting and decision will directly determine short‑term policy rate path and guidance for markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines note Fed hold/hike debate and investor focus on upcoming Fed decisions after strong jobs data.

catalysts.title: Ongoing Fed speeches and guidance
catalysts.description: Continued public comments from Fed officials (Waller and others) will shape forward guidance and market interpretation of policy direction.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Waller Urges Patience', 'Top Fed official signals support for rate hold', and commentary driving market reaction.

catalysts.title: Norway sovereign fund proposed cuts to U.S. Treasuries
catalysts.description: The Norges Bank Investment Management proposal to materially cut U.S. Treasury holdings could trigger large, phased portfolio sales and reallocation by other institutions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Manager of Norway’s $2tn oil fund proposes slashing US Treasury holdings' and 'plans to cut U.S. Treasury holdings.'

catalysts.title: Continuation of global bond sell‑off
catalysts.description: Momentum from recent yield rises and fresh macro prints may sustain further selling pressure across sovereign bond markets in the coming weeks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Global bond sell-off likely not over yet', 'Bond Yields Rocket', and broad commentary on tipping point.

catalysts.title: Heightened political pressure on Fed from Trump
catalysts.description: Public threats from political actors (threatening trade halts unless Fed cuts rates) will increase political scrutiny and pressure on monetary policy communications.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump doubles down on threat to halt trade with top partners unless Fed cuts rates' and related coverage.

catalysts.title: Banks delay/shift Fed‑cut forecasts
catalysts.description: Major banks revising and pushing back expected Fed rate‑cut timing will feed into market pricing and investor positioning.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Citi delays Fed rate-cut forecast to 2027' and 'Citi pushes Fed rate-cut forecast to June 2027.'
